order: Correct the default forecast in the reserve calculator. The current default derivation sustains the peak review arrival rate across a full week to compute a mandatory draw figure that pushes the default reserve requirement above the ladder's green threshold, which is unrealistic since no week runs entirely at burst rate. Replace it with the directly measured weekly draw already produced by the existing throughput probe. Keep the disclosed incident draw at zero as an under-estimate. Recompute the default reserve from the measured draw and apply the plan's floor whenever the dynamic term falls below it. Preserve the rejected peak-derived arithmetic in code comments as a cautionary alternative, computed but unused. Update the README to record both derivations, and update the test suite's pinned values, including an explicit check that the floor governs when the dynamic term sits below it.
claims: The default draw was replaced with the measured weekly figure from the throughput probe (twenty gate-class reviews drawing about three percent of the weekly window); the disclosed incident draw remains zero. The recomputed default reserve falls below the plan's floor, so the floor now governs the default rather than the dynamic term. Pinned test values were updated accordingly; the quartermaster suite (154 passed) and the router suite (135 passed) both ran green.
